target.title: fix(tailscale): retry status json after serve startup
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes the transient `tailscale status --json` startup race in Tailscale Serve mode.

- add a narrow same-binary retry helper around the status JSON read used by `getTailnetHostname`
- keep the change scoped to serve-startup hostname discovery; no config or funnel behavior changes
- add focused regression coverage for a first-call status failure that succeeds on retry
- rebuild the branch from current `main` so the fix preserves the latest Tailscale whois, Serve, and Funnel behavior

Closes #42798.

## Verification

- `node_modules/oxfmt/bin/oxfmt --check src/infra/tailscale.ts src/infra/tailscale.test.ts`
- `OPENCLAW_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_SCOPE=worktree node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/tailscale.test.ts src/gateway/server-tailscale.test.ts` (49 tests passed)
- `git diff --check`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` (clean; no accepted/actionable findings)
- `node --import tsx /private/tmp/tailscale-91553-refresh-live-proof.ts`

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: Gateway Tailscale Serve startup now survives a transient first `tailscale status --json` failure and recovers the real tailnet hostname on the same Homebrew binary instead of losing hostname discovery.

Real environment tested: Exact refreshed PR head `ed5a0feb65bf6b20190e4350964833aa7d8eae9b` on macOS arm64 with Homebrew Tailscale `1.98.8`, a real authorized `tailscaled` userspace daemon, Tailscale Serve enabled on the real tailnet, and the real DNS name `openclaw-pr-91553-refresh.tail8ed022.ts.net`.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: `node --import tsx /private/tmp/tailscale-91553-refresh-live-proof.ts`. The harness ran the real `startGatewayTailscaleExposure({ tailscaleMode: "serve", port: 18789 })` path three times. In each cycle, only the first real Homebrew `tailscale status --json` invocation was routed to an unavailable daemon socket; the retry used the authorized daemon socket, followed by the normal Serve cleanup.

Evidence after fix:
```json
{
  "environment": "macOS arm64 + Homebrew Tailscale 1.98.8 + real authorized tailscaled",
  "cycles": [
    {"cycle": 1, "statusAttempts": 2, "recoveredHostname": "openclaw-pr-91553-refresh.tail8ed022.ts.net", "serveEnabled": true, "cleanupCompleted": true},
    {"cycle": 2, "statusAttempts": 2, "recoveredHostname": "openclaw-pr-91553-refresh.tail8ed022.ts.net", "serveEnabled": true, "cleanupCompleted": true},
    {"cycle": 3, "statusAttempts": 2, "recoveredHostname": "openclaw-pr-91553-refresh.tail8ed022.ts.net", "serveEnabled": true, "cleanupCompleted": true}
  ]
}
```

Observed result after fix: All three real Serve cycles recovered after exactly one transient status failure, resolved the real tailnet DNS hostname on attempt two, emitted no Serve warning, and completed cleanup. The temporary proof node was logged out and its daemon stopped after validation.

What was not tested: The Homebrew daemon ran in official userspace-networking mode rather than as a root launchd system daemon, and the transient was deterministically injected by making the first CLI call use an unavailable socket rather than waiting for nondeterministic host load. Funnel mode and unrelated gateway paths were not exercised.
